column1: # Spanish names for the stars page and the pass pages (SPEC FR-STAR-10 as amended v2.5, V25-16).
# con: key is the IAU abbreviation, part is the figure's part (Serpens has two, plus "all" for its one name in the Among column); every one of the 88 has a row.
# star: key is the IAU WGSN name as catalog.json carries it; only names with an established Spanish form have a row; every other star keeps its IAU name.
# Source: the standard Spanish names (Spanish-language astronomy usage, as in es.wikipedia "Anexo:Constelaciones"), written 2026-10-25 for the owner's review.
